mechanismOfAction.summary: Prodrug deacetylated to 6-MAM and morphine, both potent μ-opioid receptor (MOR) full agonists.
mechanismOfAction.description: Diacetylmorphine itself has low MOR affinity — its effects come from rapid stepwise deacetylation to 6-monoacetylmorphine (6-MAM, t½ ~6–25 min, a potent MOR full agonist) and then morphine. Both metabolites are active and present simultaneously. The diacetyl groups confer higher lipophilicity than morphine, accelerating blood-brain barrier penetration and accounting for the faster perceived onset after injection. Oral bioavailability is low (~35%) due to extensive first-pass deacetylation.

bindings.notes: Via active metabolites 6-MAM and morphine; diacetylmorphine itself has low MOR affinity.
